about_the_game:
Gemmiferous is a Match 3 roguelike inspired by the likes of 'Slay the Spire,' 'You Must Build a Boat,' and the classic game 'Bejeweled.

Explore the vast dungeons beneath your manor and uncover old, hidden treasures. But beware of the dark and long-forgotten horrors that also lurk in these dungeons.

Choose your way carefully.

Collect gems, coins, and materials, and use them to repair the manor and its surrounding village.

Purchase various upgrades in the village shops, visit the tavern, and gamble all your hard-earned gems. Set up production of materials in the nearby forest, stone quarry, and iron mine. Decorate your village with the goal of making this place a new home for the people. Uncover all the mysteries of the manor and the village.

Features

  • 5 Playable Characters: As a lord, you will hire rogues to enter the dungeons for you, each offering a slightly different playstyle to keep the game fresh.

  • 60+ Monsters: Create a wide variety of challenges.

  • Random Event Rooms: The game offers a wide variety of random event rooms, bringing some RNG luck to the game, inspired by Darkest Dungeon and Slay the Spire.

  • Fast-Paced Combat: In this game, you must think and match quickly in order to stay alive.

  • Upgrade Your Weapons and Items: Spend coins and gems in the village shops to make your next run more successful.

  • Repair the Manor and Village: Repair the manor and village to gain access to many available facilities.

  • Build Houses and Decorate the Village: Build houses and decorate the village to increase your population.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04 32-bit or Ubuntu 12.10 32-bit
  • Processor: 2.6GHz single core
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible video card with 256 MB shared or dedicated RAM (ATI or NVIDIA)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Gemmiferous is a fusion of Match-3 combat style and Roguelite Dungeon Crawler. Explore vast dungeons, assemble unique tile sets, uncover hidden treasures, discover powerful relics, fight long-forgotten creatures, and, most importantly, have fun doing so.
